source: Nuxt 5 upgrades to {0}Nitro v3{/0}, which is a major rewrite of the server engine. Nitro v3 is built on {1}srvx{/1} and {2}h3 v2{/2}, adopting Web standard {3}/{4} APIs throughout. This brings performance improvements and a more consistent API, but includes several breaking changes to server-side code.
